operations.title: The product-exponent condition is sufficient for arbitrary finite kernel monodromy
operations.statement: For any finite M-action on any finite K, gcd(n,exp(K)*exp(M))=1 implies every fiber power map in K semidirect M -> M is bijective and hence both Mackey squares commute.
operations.scope: Sufficient direction only for arbitrary nonabelian K; basis-level correspondence.

operations.title: Quaternion C3 monodromy has the full product-exponent spectrum
operations.statement: For Q8 semidirect C3 -> C3 with cyclic permutation of i,j,k, global fiber compatibility holds iff gcd(n,12)=1.
operations.scope: Exact finite control; does not prove the arbitrary-kernel converse.

operations.title: Q8 semidirect C3 twisted-fiber spectrum test
operations.protocol: Exhaust all three fibers and n=1..24; compare compatibility to gcd(n,12)=1 and record failed fibers.
operations.falsifier: Any index disagrees with the units-modulo-12 spectrum.

operations.title: Quaternion-monodromy twisted power spectrum research packet

operations.outcome: pass: survivors are exactly units modulo 12; odd multiples of 3 fail only nonidentity fibers; 13824 exact checks

evidence.paraphrase: Exact fiber failure pattern isolates kernel prime two and monodromy prime three.
